mastery_task.scenario_en: A fictional classmate describes three people in a slow voice message.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: زميل خيالي يصف ثلاثة أشخاص في رسالة صوتية بطيئة.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Choose the correct people map and record two facts about each named person.
mastery_task.support: Two full plays and unlabeled fictional people visuals only; no transcript or answer labels.
mastery_task.freshness: New people, relationships, descriptions, pets, order, and voice differ from all models.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: A fictional neighbour describes a different small family group.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: جار خيالي يصف مجموعة عائلية مختلفة.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Select the new people map and record two facts for each person.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Two full plays and unlabeled fictional people visuals only; no transcript or answer labels.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: Different relationships, descriptions, quantities, and order preserve the listening construct.

rubric.level_2: The people, relationships, and requested fact types are understood.
Two accurate facts are recorded for each of three people.
A changed order, voice, and family structure are mapped without a transcript.
No fact crosses to the wrong person; one replay is used instead of guessing.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح إزاي اسم أو علاقة جديدة تعمل بطاقة شخص جديدة وتمنع خلط الحقائق.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Map two people and two facts each.
Distinguish one changed people or sound detail.
Map a fresh three-person family message.
